title: Stop renting access to Word and Excel with a one-time Office 2024 license for $113
content:
Macworld

TL;DR: Get Microsoft Office 2024 Home for Mac or PC for $112.97 (MSRP $149.99) through October 4, with lifetime access to Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.

If you only need the core Office apps, you don’t necessarily have to sign up for Microsoft 365 and keep paying for access. Microsoft Office 2024 Home gives you the desktop versions of Word, Excel, and PowerPoint with a one-time purchase, and it’s currently available for $112.97, down from its $149.99 MSRP.

This version of Office comes with

  • Word
  • Excel
  • PowerPoint

The layout is clean and familiar, but easier to use. The Ribbon automatically adjusts to show only what you need, and you can pin your favorite tools to the Quick Access Bar. Accessibility options are better, too, making it easier to create documents everyone can read.

Real-time co-authoring makes it simple to work on a file with others, and built-in comments help when you need feedback. Office 2024 also adds AI features such as text suggestions in Word and improved data handling in Excel.

Don’t get stuck paying for apps you’ll never own.

Until October 4 at 11:59 p.m. PT, you can get a lifetime license to Microsoft Office 2024 Home for PC or Mac for $112.97.
